newsitem.title: CHINA: China's top 10 firms make majority of profits.
newsitem.headline: China's top 10 firms make majority of profits.

text.p: The profits of China's top 10 state-owned industrial firms accounted for 52.4 percent of total profits of 18,000 major state firms in 1996, according to a survey published in the Financial News on Wednesday.
The survey by the State Statistical Bureau reviewed the profit performances of 18,000 large- and medium-sized state-owned firms in the first 11 months of 1996, the newspaper said.

The 10 top firms included the Daqing Petroleum Administration of northeastern Heilongjiang province, Yuxi Hongtashan Tobacco Group Corp in southwestern Yunnan province and three Shanghai companies -- Shanghai Volkswagen Corp, Baoshan Iron and Steel Complex Corp and Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd, it said, but gave no further details.
